name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> form (domain=gfx-implied via set_vga_palette). Accurately reflects body: writes a VGA DAC palette range with an additive brightness offset (the '_with_add' suffix correctly distinguishes it from the subtract sister fd2_set_vga_palette_range). No address residue. Keep.
purpose: Write VGA DAC palette entries over [start_idx, end_idx], adding brightness_add to each R/G/B channel and saturating at 0x3F (VGA 6-bit channel max).
logic_summary: for idx in start_idx..end_idx (signed <=): out 0x3C8, idx; then for each of the 3 channels: val = vga_palette_data[idx*3 + k] + brightness_add; if (val > 0x3F) val = 0x3F; out 0x3C9, val. Source bytes come from data_fd2_vga_palette_data_ptr (768-byte base palette). It is the additive counterpart of fd2_set_vga_palette_range (which subtracts and clamps to 0). brightness_add=0 reproduces the base palette; brightness_add>=0x3F saturates all channels to full white. __CHK(0x18) Watcom stack-probe prologue is compiler-generated.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_set_vga_palette_range_with_add(uint32 start_idx, uint32 end_idx, uint32 brightness_add)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: First VGA palette index to write (start of inclusive range).
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is generic placeholder param_1. Body uses it as the loop start index written to port 0x3C8; src declaration already calls it start_idx. Rename applied in Stage 2.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Last VGA palette index to write (inclusive loop bound, signed <= compare).
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is generic placeholder param_2. Body uses it as the inclusive upper loop bound; src declaration already calls it end_idx. Rename applied in Stage 2.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Additive brightness offset applied to each R/G/B channel before the 0x3F saturation cap.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is generic placeholder param_3. Body adds it to each palette channel byte; src declaration already calls it brightness_add. Rename applied in Stage 2.

returns.semantics: No return value; writes directly to VGA DAC ports 0x3C8/0x3C9.

comment_original_issue: src comment characterized the routine solely as 'Used for fade-from-black', which is misleading: the additive saturate-to-white behavior means add=0 yields the base palette and add>=0x3F yields full white, so the dominant caller usage (fd2_animate_palette_flash_pulse_white, fd2_palette_overbright_settle_step_loop, end-chapter cinematics) is a white-flash / over-bright pulse (base->white->base), not a black->base fade. The sibling fd2_palette_overbright_settle_step_loop comment in the same file already notes 'NOT a fade to black'.
notes: Logic confirmed correct vs decompile; no equivalence concerns. All callers verified to pass (0, 0xFF, brightness) over the full DAC range. Name and signature already compliant in src. Only the src comment was rewritten (and the Ghidra plate aligned to match) to correct the 'fade-from-black' mischaracterization. Param renames (param_1/2/3 -> start_idx/end_idx/brightness_add) recorded only; to be applied in Stage 2.
